Torso mostly faces forward with a slight turn toward screen-left. pose_text_ja: 腰を床の高さに置いて上体を起こし、ほぼ前を向いて座る。両膝を曲げて腰より前へ置く。画面左の膝は緩めに曲げ、すねを画面左へ広く伸ばし、足をその膝より大きく左へ置く。画面右の膝は直角近くまで強く曲げ、すねを画面右へ伸ばし、足をその膝より大きく右へ置く。両足とつま先は体の横から前に見え、足裏を少し見る側へ向ける。どちらの足もお尻の後ろへしまわない。低い非対称の膝を曲げた床座りで、開脚や片膝立ちではない。両肘を体の近くで曲げ、開いた両手を口と頬へ上げ、指先を口の高さ、手のひらを顔側と緩く上へ向ける。頭を起こして顔を前へ向け、顎を少し上げ、目は前を見る。
pose_template: Sit with the pelvis at floor level and the torso upright, facing nearly forward. Both knees are bent and positioned in front of the hips. The knee on screen-left is moderately bent, and its lower leg extends broadly outward to screen-left; the foot is far left of that knee. The knee on screen-right is more sharply bent near a right angle, and its shin extends outward to screen-right; the rightmost foot is far right of that knee. Both feet and toes are visible beside and in front of the body, with soles angled partly toward the viewer. Neither foot is tucked behind the buttocks. This is a low asymmetrical bent-knee floor sit, not a split and not a kneeling lunge. Bend both elbows close to the torso and lift the two open hands to the mouth and cheeks, fingertips around mouth height, palms angled inward and gently upward toward the face. Head upright, face forward, chin slightly lifted, eyes forward.
